settings.heading: Condition and Grade? Let Us Explain...

settings.text: Not all surplus pumps and equipment were created equal. So use this handy guide and always know what you’re buying. There are four condition levels, each with A, B, or C grading scores:

settings.top_container_text: Brand new, purchased directly from original manufacturer.
settings.top_container_text2: Unused/Never placed in service. Overruns, liquidations etc.
settings.top_container_text3: Torn down, cleaned, evaluated. Worn parts replaced, ready to go.
settings.top_container_text4: Previously placed in service, shop inspected, guaranteed working.
settings.A_block_text1: Perfect, factory-fresh. Still new in box. Most times will include original factory warranty.
settings.A_block_text2: Near perfect, factory like new condition. Little to no shelf wear, or cosmetic issues. Flawless performance.
settings.A_block_text3: Perfect or near perfect, factory like-new condition. Fully restored to original (or better) factory tolerances and performance.
settings.A_block_text4: Excellent condition functionally and cosmetically, very light use and/or noticeable wear.

settings.B_block_text2: Excellent condition with light to moderate shelf wear or cosmetic issues. Flawless performance.
settings.B_block_text4: Good condition functionally but might have some cosmetic issues and visible wear from light to moderate use.

settings.B_block_text2: Good condition with moderate to heavy shelf wear. Might require very minor parts replacement or servicing.
settings.B_block_text4: Rough condition but still expected to be usable, although not necessarily to factory standards.

settings.warranty_content_one: We’re going to make this really easy on you. Pumps and process equipment can be complicated, and buying online even more so... that’s why we work to take the risk off you. Every item we sell is covered by our Triple Promise Warranty:
settings.warranty_content_box:
We Don't Sell Junk

Many of the pumps and parts we sell are surplus, rebuilt, aftermarket, used etc. but we’re no surplus or salvage yard! Every single item on this site has been closely evaluated by our shop team. We carefully measure tolerances and overall item quality to ensure performance and reliability.
settings.warranty_content_box2:
Easy (and Free) Returns

You can change your mind, and return any in-stock item in the same condition as it was received, for a full refund of the purchase price. No restocking fees, no hassles. If it was our mistake, we’ll even refund the shipping! Want to return after using the item? See next pomise...
settings.warranty_content_box3:
Minimum 1-Year Warranty

Like we said above, we don’t sell junk. If it’s listed for sale on PumpRack.com, regardless of the condition or grade, we will provide a full parts and labor warranty for at least 1-year from the time of purchase. For Viking® aftermarket pumps and parts, we extend that to 2-years. And for our Rebuilt Pumps, we extend to 3-years!

We have a formal statement of warranty for easy download and printing, if you’re into that sort of thing.

settings.Build_Content:
Our full-service pump shop can do just about anything. We’re fast and flexible. And if you’re ordering the parts from us, most times we’ll do the work for free!

Contact us and let’s talk shop. Some of our services include:
settings.Build_to_order_content_box: PS: We also offer pump repair and rebuild services including no-obligation estimates and free shipping!
